name: ckz_eff2500_cfg_interval
_design: Native cfg_interval=(min,max) sigma where classifier-free guidance is applied; outside it CFG is skipped while the LoRA stays FULLY ON (timbre safe, no muffle). Gating CFG off early (sigma>X) lets the unconditional base+LoRA own early/structure steps; guidance refines toward the prompt late. The timbre-safe version of the time-gate. (0,1)=control. Tests whether removing early prompt-pull diversifies melody without degrading timbre. 4 seeds.
